## Appearance

Mr. Harrison is a short, fat, and bald man with a round face and prominent blue eyes. When dressed, he maintains a neat and snug appearance.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008)_

## Personality

Harrison is a crusty, crabbed, and lonesome man who has earned a reputation as an odd crank. Despite describing himself as a terribly outspoken individual, he is also an awfully kind person who shows outward sympathy.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008)_

## History

Originally from [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), Mr. J. A. Harrison spent time on Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) as a boy and kept house with his sister until her death. Following a promise to his sister, he married [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott and took a two-week wedding trip to St. John before they went home, though they eventually separated. Upon moving to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), he angrily confronted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when her cow broke into his oats. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later mistakenly sold Harrison's cow, but when she confessed, he calmly accepted her cow in exchange and shared tea with her.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P20](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0020), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), +23 more_

## Quotes

> "Sorry, miss! Sorry isn’t going to help matters any. You’d better go and look at the havoc that animal has made in my oats . . . trampled them from center to circumference, miss."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P17](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0017)

> "He’s . . . he’s always talking nonsense. I got him from my brother who was a sailor. Sailors don’t always use the choicest language, and parrots are very imitative birds."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006)

> "has she gone and broken into my oats again? Well, never mind . . . never mind if she has. It’s no difference . . . none at all, I . . . I was too hasty yesterday, that’s a fact. Never mind if she has."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P9](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0009)

> "I don’t, that’s a fact, and I’m mighty fond of it, too. I’m much obliged to you. It looks good on top. I hope it’s good all the way through."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P29](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0029)

> "Well, I’ll tell you what, miss, you must help me eat it. I’ll put the kettle on and we’ll have a cup of tea. How will that do?"
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P31](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0031)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--harrison.md)

Harrison and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) begin their acquaintance on bad terms after Harrison angrily confronts her over her cow damaging his oats, an issue compounded when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally sells Harrison's cow by mistake. However, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits to confess her error and exchange cows, the two bond over tea and become good friends and neighbors. They regularly converse about local affairs and teaching philosophies, though Harrison occasionally clashes with her, such as when he flatly refuses her request for a fundraising subscription.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), +25 more_

- Friend of — neighbors who become good friends  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), +1 more</sub>

### [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harrison--john-henry-carter.md)

Harrison serves as the employer of young [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006)_

- Commands — employer of little John Henry Carter  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006)</sub>

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harrison--rachel-lynde.md)

Harrison and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) maintain a relationship described as armed neutrality. Harrison frequently discusses her and her village projects with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), while [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) stays informed of community gossip involving Harrison.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), +6 more_
